title: two fingers spreading on a photo viewer zoom it

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
the second finger reaches the page
the fingers spreading zoom the page in

notes: reported in words rather than a scale factor: the question is whether two pointers exist at all, and a numeric zoom would flap on a pixel of cross-half layout difference. The pinch begins where the page's own measurement does — when the second finger lands — and the two paths are sampled at the same instants so the replay moves both touch points together
